editorial_requirements: Cover at least six distinct calculation skills.
Every question needs an independent arithmetic verification ledger.
Use fictional but realistic data and state every assumption needed for an answer.
All five numeric options for each question must be in ascending order.
Answer labels must be reasonably balanced without a detectable repeated cycle.
excluded_topics: Income tax bands, drug dosage, hospital bed occupancy, train fares, household energy mix, charity fundraising, gym memberships, and swimming pools are already heavily represented.
